backend/main.mo: Primary canister actor managing submissions, posts, ingestion, user profiles, brand image, and admin‑gated actions using access control and storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new format by adding an empty ingestionSources map.
backend/post-helper.mo: Helper module defining post types and processing raw content into standardized ProcessedPost structures with category utilities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing frontend file roles, routing, components, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint including root div, main script loader, and Google Search Console verification tag.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration wiring all site pages including admin automation and ingestion routes.
frontend/src/components/content/AccessDe: UI screen showing an authorization error message with a link back to the home page.
frontend/src/components/content/FormStat: Renders a styled success or error banner with an icon and message based on form status.
frontend/src/components/content/UpdateCa: Displays an update preview card with image, category, date, title, excerpt, and navigation to the full post.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Provides a multi-column footer with about text, quick links, state links, and legal pages.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Defines the site’s main layout including header, optional breadcrumbs, routed content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Generates breadcrumb navigation based on the current URL path.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Mobil: Implements a slide-in mobile navigation menu with search, main links, state links, and footer links.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Renders the site header with logo, desktop nav links, search button, and mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/content/seedUpdates.ts: Provides sample update items with metadata and HTML body content for seeding the app.
frontend/src/content/updateTypes.ts: Defines update categories, item structure, and a helper to map categories to display labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGuard.ts: Checks if the authenticated user is an admin and exposes loading and authorization states.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutomationSettings: Provides queries and mutations for ingestion sources, automated ingestion, and brand image management via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendPosts.ts: Fetches published posts or a single post by ID from the backend and adapts them into frontend update items.
frontend/src/hooks/useCombinedUpdates.ts: Combines backend posts with seed updates and provides category filtering, latest updates, and ID lookup.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, including login state, stored identities, and context access.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines mutations for submitting contact forms and manually ingesting content, invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, theme variables, typography, and utility classes for the site.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, services, commitments, and contact information metadata and content.
frontend/src/pages/AdmitCardsPage.tsx: Displays admit card-related updates filtered by category with metadata, descriptions, and update cards.
frontend/src/pages/AutomationSettingsPag: Admin page for managing ingestion sources and brand image settings with add, remove, and trigger actions.
Displays competitive exam categories and latest updates using fetched exam-related content.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact form page with validation and submission handling, showing success or error banners.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Static disclaimer page outlining information limits, verification requirements, and liability terms.
frontend/src/pages/EducationNewsPage.tsx: Lists education news updates with category filtering and loading state handling.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page showing hero section and latest updates across multiple categories with navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 page displaying not‑found message with navigation options back home or previous page.
frontend/src/pages/OwnerIngestPage.tsx: Admin-only page providing a form to manually submit new content for ingestion with fields like title, category, body, excerpt, and state tags.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full post based on ID, loading either backend or seed data, setting SEO metadata, and rendering hero image, category, date, and HTML body.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Static privacy policy page with SEO metadata and structured sections explaining data collection, usage, security, and retention.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx: Lists exam result updates filtered by the RESULTS category, with SEO metadata and loading state handling.
frontend/src/pages/SchemesPage.tsx: Shows government scheme updates filtered by the SCHEMES category, including SEO metadata and a grid of update cards.
frontend/src/pages/ScholarshipsPage.tsx: Displays scholarship updates with state-based filtering, SEO metadata, guidance steps, and a grid of filtered update cards.
frontend/src/pages/SchoolEducationPage.t: Presents school education updates, overview sections about boards and coverage, and latest updates filtered by the SCHOOL_EDUCATION category.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Renders a search page that filters updates by query, displays results or latest updates, and syncs the query with URL parameters.
frontend/src/pages/StatePage.tsx: Displays updates filtered by a state slug and sets page metadata based on the selected state.
frontend/src/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Hook that updates document title and meta description tags when page metadata changes.
frontend/src/utils/backendPostAdapters.t: Converts backend Post objects into normalized UpdateItem entries with mapped categories and formatted dates.
frontend/src/utils/searchUpdates.ts: Provides search utilities to normalize queries, match updates, and return results sorted by date.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters, supporting both query strings and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing automation goals, existing features, new feature requests, and architectural notes.
